search.criterion: out-of-fold nDCG@10 over the artist-disjoint train folds (P@10 and mAP reported); early stopping on an in-train holdout; val never used
search.note: anchors change ONE thing from the base config (depth 1, 512 units, dropout 0.25, wd 0.1, lr 1e-3, cosine, batch 128, mean pooling, bce); the rest is random search

final.selection: top 3 of 22 search configs by train-CV nDCG@10 (+ the CV-best by P@10 if different)

attn.note: all four poolings share the same body and head (equal capacity; attention adds d or 2*128*d parameters); `mean` is the mean-pooling control on exactly the same rows and standardisation
